component.name: Brolga
component.summary: Mail, calendar and contacts for Microsoft 365

description.p: Brolga is a desktop client for Microsoft 365 mail, calendar and contacts. It keeps a copy of your mailbox on your computer, so you can read, search and write with no connection, and what you do is sent when you are back.

ul.li: Mail with folders, conversations, search, rules and categories
Calendar with meetings, invitations, free and busy times and reminders
Contacts, your organisation's directory and shared mailboxes
Remote pictures stay out until you ask, and nothing in a message runs
Old mail read in from Outlook data files
A command line, and a server for AI agents that can only read unless you say otherwise

description.p: Brolga is an independent project. It is not made or endorsed by the maker of Microsoft 365.

screenshot.caption: Folders, the message list and a message open beside them
A working week in the calendar

description.p: After a merge the folder list is right at once, with no emptied folder left behind and the new counts shown. A long folder list scrolls under a folder dragged to its top or foot. The move dialog and folder menu no longer glow in a dark theme.
A folder moved to where a folder of the same name already is can be merged into it: its messages and folders go across, and it is removed once empty.
A folder can be moved into another: drag it there and agree to it, or right-click it and choose Move to.

Many fixes from a review of the whole program: keys and actions reach the message they are meant for, a message cannot be sent by mistake or without its files, one folder that fails no longer holds up the rest, and an agent's request to send shows exactly what would go.
Public holidays can be added as a calendar, for a country or one of its states. Read mail stands back so that bold means unread, and the small calendar shows the days on view as one band.
The mailbox you have chosen has its folders first, with the others under their own names, and a folder opened in a shared mailbox stays open while mail is fetched.
A message that has been answered or forwarded is marked, whether that was done here or in another mail program.
Mail syncs again: 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 asked Microsoft 365 for something it refuses, and fetched nothing.
A bar along the bottom says what is being fetched, every folder has its newest mail before any is fetched whole, and a newer Brolga is offered and installed from the window.
Several messages can be chosen and acted on together, each line of the list shows its sender's initials, and a message that has been answered or sent on is marked.
On a dark desktop a styled message is darkened to suit, keeping its colours' hue.
A message is shown as it was laid out, with its own colours and tables. Blocked pictures are offered with Show blocked content and Trust sender.
Run as an AppImage, signing in and links in messages open your browser.
Signing in on Windows works: a sign-in longer than one entry of the system's secret store holds is kept in several.
The first build for testing: mail, calendar, contacts, shared mailboxes and archives.
